# CANDIDATE: TOM_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Turn-of-month bias produces upward drift in SPY; combining this seasonal tendency with a bullish EMA ribbon stack (5>10>20) and price > VWAP creates a high-probability long setup. The edge exists because month-end/beginning liquidity flows and institutional rebalancing create persistent bias, while the EMA ribbon confirms short-term momentum alignment.

## Mechanism

Entry: If today is the last trading day of the month OR one of the first two trading days of the month, AND 5-EMA > 10-EMA > 20-EMA (bullish ribbon), AND price > VWAP, AND no gap down >0.2% from prior close, THEN enter long at the close of the bar satisfying all conditions. Exit: Initial stop at recent swing low (chart-stop) or 0.5% (whichever tighter); target 1.5R; upon reaching 1R move stop to break-even, then trail with chandelier stop at 1.5×ATR(14). Regime filter: VIX < 16 and time after 10:00 ET; avoid FOMC/major news days.
